content: Phase 41 implementation (3.5.0) on branch phase-41-review-loop-efficiency — plan docs/phases/review-loop-efficiency.md, all rounds' contracts implemented (see 'Implementation notes'). (A) gatekeeper.on_submit: cycle add/init SUBMIT_FOR_REVIEW run the gate synchronously via run_gate (kind=manual, same claim path), print verdict + next step, exit 0 either way; --no-gate skips only the synchronous run; gate check --skip-tests; entry carries 'checked: HEAD <sha>'; on_submit note. Tests: tests/test_gatekeeper.py::TestOnSubmit (10). (B) watcher: watcher.resend_minutes (default 15, 0=never), per-seq watchdog record, positive-idle + unchanged-tail rule with 30s probe throttle, max 2 re-sends then one notification, reset on seq change, capture failure never sends, 8-line capture with busy markers over the whole capture; tests/test_watcher.py (16 new incl. iterm2+tmux matrix). (C) SKILL both copies: one-run rule (lead) + on-submit gate paragraph + reviewer waits for an owed gate. (D) scripts/release.py transactional 3-file bump (snapshot/restore on any failure, exit 2, --dry-run inert, no git) — used for this 3.5.0 bump; tests/test_release_script.py (14 incl. fake uv write-then-fail and CITATION write failure). Docs: how-tagteam-works (#one-run, watchdog), README, CLI help, init template comments. This repo has on_submit: true — this very submission was gated by the on-submit run (see the GATE entry for the suite result and checked commit); I ran no separate full suite.

Amendment: the on-submit gate's log (.tagteam/gates/review-loop-efficiency_impl_r1_gate_20260817T021403Z_a1.log) reads '1265 passed, 5 skipped in 247.01s' @ bec60d8. Known gap, not yet fixed in the tree (so the checked commit stays bec60d8): with 'pytest -q' the summary line has no '===' bars and _summarize_test_output does not extract 'N passed, M skipped' into the entry — I will fix the regex (accept the bare -q form) with a test in round 2 alongside your findings, so the entry carries the numbers as the plan requires.

The implementation is broadly aligned and the focused gate/release/watcher tests pass (58 passed), but one plan-required item is missing:

The recorded GATE_PASS entry for this submission is:
`GATE: PASS | scope 17 paths | plan-doc ok | tests ok (4m07s)`
`checked: HEAD bec60d8`
It does not carry the runner's pytest summary (`N passed, M skipped in T s`) required by the approved plan and needed for the reviewer to verify the one-run report. `_summarize_test_output` currently only recognizes the equals-delimited pytest format, while `pytest -q` emits the plain summary line. Make the gate persist that summary in the GATE entry for PASS/BOUNCE (and retain it in status/report output), add a regression assertion covering the actual `pytest -q` form, then resubmit. No full-suite rerun is needed beyond the gate's existing run unless the fix changes test execution itself.
